data.notes_barbara:
Same core products; Overlapping customers

Asure offers payroll, HR, tax and time-management software to small and midsize employers. Both the products and customer segment overlap.
data.notes_matthew: Asure sells payroll, tax, human resources and time tracking software to small and mid-sized employers, and its 10-K literally names Paylocity as a main competitor. It's much smaller at $140M but it's the same business.

data.reason: Cloud HCM with payroll, HR, time and tax filing for small and mid-sized US employers, matching the target.
Sells cloud payroll, HR, time and tax-filing software to small and mid-sized employers on subscription, with payroll services.
Cloud HCM with payroll, HR, time and tax filing sold by subscription to US small and mid-sized employers.
Subscription cloud payroll, HR, time and attendance software with payroll processing and tax filing for small and mid-sized employers.

Both sell cloud payroll, tax filing, HR and benefits software on one platform to US employers. Paylocity serves boutiques through growing franchises and associations. Asure serves employers nationwide, with run-it-yourself and managed-service options. Both are subscription platforms with payroll service layers.
Both provide employers with connected payroll and HR software, employee self-service and compliance support. Asure's optional managed services do not remove its direct platform overlap.

P1.1.text: Unify HR, Finance, & IT | HR & Payroll Simplified | Paylocity

P1.2.text: Paylocity unifies HR, Finance, and IT on one HCM platform, so you can stop piecing systems together and start moving forward together.

P1.3.text: The next evolution of work is here to automate manual processes, reduce risk, and help you move faster.

P1.5.text: Power every team with a single software

P1.6.text: Our flexible solutions drive innovation, enable smarter decisions, transform workforces, fuel growth, and inspire confident leadership.

P1.7.text: Simplify payroll and filing taxes with an intuitive, modern platform and expert support, knowing your payroll is accurate each time.

P1.8.text: Transform spend management – real-time visibility, AI-powered automation, seamless integration, smarter workflows.

P1.9.text: Centralize asset management, access control, and service support – empowering IT to enable the business, not just support it.

P1.10.text: A Payroll bundle is any new purchase of Payroll, standalone or bundled with other products.

P1.11.text: “It was everything we needed, all in one place. Paylocity’s solution helped modernize the entire employee experience.”

P1.12.text: “Paylocity helps us automate manual tasks, save time, and improve our decision-making with data and reporting.”

P1.13.text: What connects it all sets us apart

P1.14.text: Stay informed, engaged, and productive with one mobile experience.

P1.15.text: Automation and insight embedded in daily processes make everyone more efficient.

P1.16.text: Seamless connections across all your tools that unify data and user experience.

P1.17.text: Real-time dashboards and guided actions turn data into decisions.

P1.18.text: Automated processes from end to end save time and improve accuracy.

P1.19.text: Dedicated partnership and support you can count on.

P1.20.text: The ultimate platform for today's workforce

P1.21.text: Paylocity brings HR, Finance, and IT together to empower teams, simplify processes, and deliver real results. But we're more than a platform — we're the partner helping you shape the future of work.

P1.22.text: We stand by your side to help you hit your goals. Our ideas are grounded in your real needs — not in guesswork.

P1.23.text: Innovation is at the heart of what we do.

P1.24.text: Clients say we deliver the best service, and we strive to keep every interaction clear, helpful, and human.

P1.26.text: Dive into the latest research from industry leaders, and get the practical insights you need to automate smarter, act on real data, and make better workforce decisions.

P1.27.text: Bring HR and Finance together to streamline operations and control company-wide expenses in one place.

P1.28.text: The next evolution of work is here.

P1.29.text: Connect. Learn. Get more from Paylocity. Join us November 4-5

P1.30.text: Import your W-2 directly from Paylocity to one of three tax preparers at no cost and get a head start on your refund.

P2.2.text: From the just-starting-out local boutique to the rapidly growing franchises, from brokerage firms to associations, we tailor solutions for today and the future.

P2.3.text: Built for teams who value connection and efficiency

P2.4.text: Executives and business owners steer the ship. You need a solution that keeps productivity up and turnover down.

P2.5.text: HR leaders are the champions of a thriving workforce, creating a culture for everyone. You need a platform that matches your passion for nurturing talent.

P2.6.text: Employees expect the right pay, every time, and payroll admins are there to get it right every time. You need tools to simplify the process and lighten your load.

P2.7.text: IT is the guardian of a company's infrastructure. You depend on systems that keep technology functioning smoothly, protect data, and scale for growth.

P2.8.text: Employees are at the heart of any business. You need simple, but impactful solution to stay connected to your coworkers and culture.

P2.9.text: For brokers, advisors, consultants, and advocates by any other name, relationships are everything. The right platform helps you deepen client relationships and grow your book

P1.2.text: Payroll, tax, and HR outsourcing — done right.

P1.3.text: Run payroll and HR yourself—or have Asure’s experts manage it for you. One platform for payroll, HR, benefits, and compliance.

P1.4.text: Get Pricing Talk to an Expert

P1.5.text: Payroll, taxes, HR, and benefits can't be wrong.

P1.6.text: Employees expect to be paid correctly. Tax agencies expect accurate filings. And employment laws change constantly. When payroll and HR go wrong, the consequences show up fast.

P1.7.text: HR team holds SHRM-CP and SHRM-SCP certifications.

P1.9.text: Type II certified for security, availability, and data integrity.

P1.10.text: Employers nationwide rely on Asure for payroll & HR.

P1.11.text: That's why employers choose Asure — because payroll and HR should be A-SURE thing.

P1.12.text: Run payroll and HR the way your business needs.

P1.13.text: Some employers prefer to manage payroll and HR internally. Others choose expert help because they don't have the time, staff, or expertise to manage it confidently.

P1.14.text: Asure supports both approaches in one environment. Run payroll yourself using our platform or rely on Asure's experts to handle the work.

P1.16.text: Use the AsureCentral platform to process payroll, manage employee records, track time, administer benefits, and give employees self-service access to their information.

P1.17.text: Have Asure experts manage payroll and HR

P1.18.text: AsureWorks provides managed payroll and HR services delivered by Asure specialists who handle the operational work for you.

P1.19.text: Payroll and HR operations managed for you.

P1.20.text: Payroll, tax filings, HR compliance, and benefits administration are complex and constantly changing. AsureWorks provides a team of specialists who run these operations for you — handling the day-to-day execution so your team can stay focused on running the business.

P1.21.text: Payroll, HR, compliance, and benefits managed together by one operational partner.

P1.22.text: Asure specialists handle the operational execution behind payroll and workforce administration.

P1.23.text: Reduce the internal time, coordination, and administrative pressure of workforce operations.

P1.24.text: The platform behind payroll and HR operations.

P1.25.text: AsureCentral powers payroll, HR, benefits, and workforce management for employers. Whether you run payroll internally or rely on AsureWorks to manage the work for you, everything operates through one connected system designed for businesses managing employees.

P1.26.text: Luna AI is built into how Asure works

P1.27.text: Luna is an embedded AI assistant across AsureCentral that helps employers, managers, and employees get answers, surface what matters, and keep payroll and HR moving without interruption.

P1.28.text: It works across the entire employee experience—from answering employee questions to helping managers take action to keeping payroll and HR operations on track—so work gets done faster, with fewer errors, and less back-and-forth.

P1.29.text: Payroll, HR, and benefits in one system.

P1.30.text: Everything you need to run payroll, manage employees, administer benefits, and stay compliant — all in one platform.

P1.34.text: Payroll and HR support at every level of complexity.

P1.35.text: Payroll and HR don't get harder just because your business is growing — they get harder as your workforce, hiring, compliance requirements, and tax obligations become more complex. Asure supports employers through every stage of that complexity.

P1.36.text: Run payroll accurately, pay employees on time, and stay compliant with basic requirements.

P1.37.text: Handle multi-state employees, changing regulations, and expanding HR responsibilities with confidence.

P1.39.text: Manage filings, funding, and compliance across more demanding payroll and tax environments.

P1.40.text: What you get when payroll and HR are done right.

P1.41.text: Payroll runs. Employees are paid correctly. Taxes are filed on time. Compliance is handled. You don't have to check it, fix it, or think about it.
